name: watchtower
description: Multi-user security posture dashboard — blends Qualys vulnerability data and Huntress ISPM compliance into a per-client grade

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace apps/api
scripts.demo:setup: node --env-file=.env.demo node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && node --env-file=.env.demo node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && node --env-file=.env.demo node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs apps/api/src/seedAdmin.ts && node --env-file=.env.demo node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs apps/api/src/seedDemo.ts
